batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b KA Jamieson

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c Washington Sundar b HV Patel

batting.name: KH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c DT Christian b HV Patel

batting.name: Washington Sundar
batting.dismissal: c CA Lynn b KH Pandya

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c CA Lynn b M Jansen

batting.name: Shahbaz Ahmed
batting.dismissal: c KH Pandya b M Jansen

batting.name: DT Christian
batting.dismissal: c RD Chahar b JJ Bumrah

balls.text: full slower ball at middle stump, waits on that and drives to long-on. Chahar wants to come back for the second, Bumrah in no position to respond. The throw goes to the striker's and that is four wickets and only a run off Mumbai's last over
another dipping yorker slips through from under Bumrah's bat. He was looking to chop that to third man

Harshal has a five-for! What a ball. This is some mastery of the slower yorker. Not this ball, but the three that set it up. Jansen is reaching out in anticipation of another, but Harshal gets this regular paced delivery to tail in from outside off, squeeze through between inside edge and front foot, and knocks the stumps

narrowly misses leg stump! Wow, you'd think Malinga is bowling here. He has nailed that slower, dipping yorker. Jansen is swishing wildly as it approaches him, well down leg side. The ball is just past leg stump

holes out to deep square! A quick offbreak, at leg stump on a length. Pollard reaching out again, third ball in a row, without control. Can only flick it high for that fielder. Harshal is on a hat-trick
taken at deep midwicket. Short of a length, pushed across leg stump. Gets into a half crouch and tries to turn that behind square. Only gets it high in front of square and that is an easy grab
gets it right again with the slower bouncer. This time Pollard reaches out and can't get a touch on it
oh that's unlucky for Jamieson. Slower short ball at middle stump, Pollard backs away and is outfoxed after shaping for the pull. It comes off the top edge and clears the keeper
slower short ball at middle stump, mistimed pull to deep square

nails the yorker, breaks the bat! Krunal is lucky the blade hasn't fallen onto his stumps. He had completed his swing and the bat was still intact after he'd gone through, with the swing taking it behind him. Then, it just breaks clean from the handle and lands safely

dropped short at middle stump, stands tall and leans into that as he pull. Gets it between deep square and deep midwicket. Jamieson looks shocked. It looks like something was up with the field...umpires confirm they had only three inside the circle! Oh that is unpardonable. Mumbai have a free hit.
short of a length and dragged out to deep midwicket

dropped at mid-off. It's Virat Kohli. Length ball just outside off, a powerful drive on the rise, flat and at Kohli's face. Straightforward, really. It looks like it's burst through his fingers and caught him above the eye. He's on his feet
offcutter at a length, Krunal is done by the drop in pace again. Awkward chip out to long-on
slower ball at a length just outside off. Completely out of shape as he looks to drive. Has to check his shot and it lands short of extra cover

they've reviewed for lbw and I reckon this is going to be out. It's a dead-on yorker at middle stump. Kishan swishes across it and misses. Struck on the back leg, right in front of middle. No bat. Yup, that will be overturned. Perhaps the umpire thought that was pitching outside leg, but it has curved subtly to land on a leg stump line and would have ripped middle stump out. Good ball, good review. Mumbai are losing steam here
dropped at deep square! Siraj puts down a sitter. Slower short ball at off stump, aerial hook fetched from away. Ends up slicing it, it goes nice and friendly to Siraj. He's under it but it pops out
length and a bit of late dip inwards, which is enough to mess with Pollard's flow. Wants to swat that straight, but it comes off the inside half and ends up at deep midwicket
short of a length and slanted into the corridor, punched back to the bowler
overpitched and just outside off, angled away from him. Looks to go leg side with that and gets it onto his boot off the inside edge
short of a length and just outside off, patted to extra cover's left off the back foot
short and up at off stump, gets right on top of that and defends into the surface
struck on the chest as he looks to evade this short ball. An inconvenient one, rising inwards and Pollard drops the bat
low full toss on the pads, whipped down to fine leg

just clears deep square, who was in a few yards! It's short and it's tucked him on the pull. He goes through, aerial, and looks like this has landed just short of the boundary padding. Sundar is striding to his right and leaping up, gets himself twisted up and misses that, to the bowler's annoyance
yorker down leg side, swishes and misses

Pandya's been given lbw and he reviews. Outfoxed by a dipping slower ball and struck on the full right in front of middle and leg. UltrEdge shows no murmurs. And tracker shows that hitting leg stump. Lovely change up from Harshal. It's a ball he's always had, and one that works well because of his quick arm action
low full toss just outside off, driven straight to extra cover
oh, expertly done. Short and rising at an off stump line. A subtle move into the leg side to make room and then he opens the face to chop between point and short third
slower ball at a length outside off, walks across to get behind the line and gently clips this to deep square's left
length and just outside off, quick this time and catching Kishan off guard. Watchfully punched to long-off
full slower ball at leg stump. Ishan is eager on the whip over backward square. Comes off the cue end and rolls back to the bowler
slower length ball at off stump, leans in and flicks to deep square
short of a length at middle stump, short arm pull to deep midwicket's left
slower short ball outside off, toe-ended pull down to long-on
short of a length just outside of, chopped straight to backward point
punched viciously past the bowler's face. Length ball, just outside off, half a stride and the full face of the bat offered. Sprints to the boundary
slams it in, short of a length and angled into the body. Hits him hard in the mid-riff as he shapes to pull
full and flatter at leg stump, good stride as he punches to long-on
full at middle stump, swept to deep square's left
oh lovely adjustment. Wanted to step out, but this was pushed flatter and wider. Kishan stops in his tracks and quickly changes shape to slash that fine of point
clobbered into the sightscreen. Tossed up outside off and he's quickly down the pitch. Swings with the turn after having to reach out a touch. Connects cleanly
legbreak dropped short outside off, spanked to sweeper point's left

legbreak at a length on leg stump. Leans in and pushes into the midwicekt region. Chahal goes after that, slides and turns swiftly on the pick up. Can't get the throw close to the stumps at the non-strikers
good length and sliding into the pads as he looks to flick through square leg

oh good catch running backwards from Sundar! Pushed through flat and at a length at middle stump. Lynn clears the front leg and looks for the big slog. That holds its line a little and he gets this off the high part of the bat. It loops behind the bowler, in the direction of long-on. AB de Villiers yells out to Washi to go after that and he tracks it perfectly over his shoulder, still in his sprint when he gets underneath that and stretches out to grab it. Keeps his balance too after that is done
length at off stump, jabbed into the covers off the front foot
length at middle stump, shuffles and gets a clumsy sweep out to deep square
hammered past the non-striker. Pushes this flat and short of a length at leg stump. Quickly on the back foot and uses his core to stay still and pump it straight
length and sliding into the stumps, leans in and jabs it down to long-on
short of a length and just outside off, hangs leg side of that and steers to third man with a late cut

just short of mid-off! Jamieson leaps forward and can't get under that. Short and rising into the body as he backs away and looks to cut over cover. That comes off the sticker and loops teasingly for the big man, who can't get there
full and wide outside off, Lynn awkwardly stuck on the back foot and having a poke at this. Beaten
length at leg stump, waits on that and tucks it to fine leg
good length and spitting up at an off stump line as he gets forward and defends
good length and just outside off, punched through the covers

thick edge and taken! Short and wide outside off, cross seam and getting a bit more stick in the surface as opposed to the last ball which skidded through. This one gets big as he reaches out for the cut and it's an easy take for AB
short and wide outside off, beaten on the cut

trademark SKY. Jamieson is going only cutters at the moment. He's figured that out. He shuffles and reaches out at this quick offbreak, meets it at off stump and uses those deadly wrists to whip it over midwicket
short of a length and strikes the back leg just outside off as he shuffles to pull
full legcutter at middle stump, clears the front leg and looks to drill that straight. Thick inside edge to deep square
offcutter at a length just outside off, shuffles and punches to long-on
short of short third man. Huge turn on that. Grips and rips from a leg stump line, Lynn has ended up trying to whip that from outside off. Leading edge lands safely
topspinner at a length on off stump, defended into the off side
short of a length and sliding through at off, cut to point's right and Patidar is swift there
good length at middle stump, deep in the crease and tucks it through square leg
length at leg stump, looks for the sweep again and gets it past the keeper via an inside edge onto pad
good length at leg stump, turning away. SKY is through the sweep too soon, cops it on the body
full and just outside off, driven firmly but can't get that past extra cover

short of a length and skidding low outside off. Slapped on the rise to sweeper's right. Sundar puts in a slide to keep that in...oh but he's touched the boundary padding before he's let go of the ball. Trailing right foot gives Mumbai two more
full and very wide outside off, left alone
short of a length outside off, backs away and slaughters that on the up to the bowler's left. Maxwell gets down quickly to his right at long-off
full at off stump, flicked to deep midwicket
chopped between backward point and short third. That's fifty for the partnership. Short of a length and into off stump, stays leg side of it and scythes that through
short of a length at the stumps, steps out and slugs this to deep midwicket
length outside off, punched on the rise to sweeper
full at middle stump, jammed down to long-on

oh, shot! That is a touch of genius from Yadav. It's a very similar delivery to the last one - short of a length and just outside off. But he uses a different option this time because driving is hard on this surface. Closes the face and drags this half-pull, half-punch wide of midwicket. Then beats long-on to the right
just short of mid-off. Short of a length and at off stump. Looks to drive on the up but that has stopped on him
slower ball at a length on leg stump, leans in and tucks into the leg side
pumps the free hit over midwicket! That is No. 1 in the areas you don't bowl at Lynn. Short, rising outside off, sitting up as he backs away and full, filthy swing from Lynn with a horizontal bat
no-ball siren! Short of a length ball outside off, chopped to sweeper cover. All good until the alarm goes off
length at the stumps, check-punch down to long-on
full and wide outside off, drilled to sweeper cover

the bowler goes quicker and is punished! Flat, short of a length and into leg stump. Lynn was backing away, exposing the stumps, and got this clean in his swinging arc. Slams into a metal board over deep midwicket
crashed past extra cover. Short of a length and turning away from middle stump. Nice and slow, but that's allowed him to create room and axe that to the extra cover boundary
full at off stump, driven neatly along the floor to long-off
length and at the stumps, waits on that and punches to long-off
short and very wide. A free hit. And he chops that between cover and extra
good length and at middle stump, driven with the turn, past the bowler
googly, short of a length and tucked on the pads. Aerial punch out to deep midwicket
googly, short of a length and at middle. Exposes the stumps and chops to cover point's left
high and long enough! Tossed up at middle and leg. Lynn steps out and isn't quite to the pitch. Gets this drive off the inside of the bat but he's hit it well enough to just clear long-on
good length and slow, just outside off. Driven on the up to extra cover
good length and just outside off, 138kph. Driven on the rise to extra cover
good length and into middle stump, flicked straight to midwicket
b>legcutter at middle stump, on a length. Waits on it and punches to sweeper cover
length and into leg stump, flicked aerially to deep square
full at middle stump, driven straight to mid-on
did I just say it's difficult to start? Suryakumar waits on this, deep in the crease. It's slammed in at a length and rising steeply because it sticks. He uses his wrists to whip that over square leg

huge mix up and Rohit is gone! Googly, short of a length and into middle stump. Lynn meekly taps it into the covers. Rohit wants the run, Lynn does not. Kohli swoops down on that and sends a throw in one the bounce to the bowler and Rohit has gone too far to recover. Massive wicket, it's not easy to start on this pitch by all indications so far and Rohit was looking good
length at leg stump, tucked through vacant midwicket
oh simply gorgeous for the first six of the season. Tossed up at middle and leg, steps out and meets that at the pitch and then extends his arms to chip that straight
good length at middle stump, waits on it this time and pats it to long-off
inside edge past leg stump! Not in control of that one. Length and sliding straight on. He backs into the leg side and looks to slap through cover. Through it early and lucky in the end
length and sliding on at middle and leg. Punched back to the bowler on the up
length and into off stump, clipped to deep square's left
just evades mid-off! Good length and just outside off. Drives on the rise and doesn't try to keep it down this time. Jamieson is 6'8'" but Rohit clears him
full and into the pads at leg stump. Leans in for the flick and misses, rapped on the front leg
past the under-edge. Short of a length in the corridor, angled inwards. Doesn't rise at all as Rohit pulls over the height of another one. AB had to lunge forward to gather that
full and just outside off, looks to force that drive on the rise through the off side and is through it soon. Slightly aerial as this ends up at mid-on
full and in at off stump, looks to drive through the off side and gets a thick inside edge into the leg side
nearly chops on! Short of a length outside off, 136kph. Lynn gives the charge and looks to slap through the covers with a horizontal bat. Inside edge just misses off
short of a length and skidding on. 139kph this time. That comes on quick and tucks Lynn at the mid-riff, trickles through to the keeper
edge dies on first slip. Not sure that would have carried to the keeper either. Good length, angled into the stumps at 129kph. Looks to drive and is caught inside the line a little bit
full and in at off stump, stays tall as he drives along the floor to mid-off. That is stock Jamieson length
good length, pitching middle and rapping him on the pads as he looks to tuck that fine. 131kph and staying a touch low
full and curving in at off stump, 128kph from wide of the crease. Clipped to mid-on's right off the front foot
good length and at middle stump. Stays still and rolls the wrists to get this out to deep square, who had dropped back for the last ball
good length and at off stump, nicely on the back foot as he defends into the off side
length and into the pads, uses the angle to nudge that to fine leg's left
short of a length and into off stump. That sticks in the pitch and comes on slower than he anticipates. Rapped on the back leg as he's through the pull shot
good length and slanted in at off stump, solidly defended on the front foot
runs straight up, Siraj strays onto the pads with a full and straight one. Tucked past square leg

nudges it to short fine and seals the win! A yorker from around the wicket from Jansen. Harshal shuffles and just manages to get the bat down in front of his toe. It's to the fielder's left and he has to lunge low and tumble to stop that. No way he can stop the single after that happens
they sneak the run. Short of a length and into the body, he's tucked up but he's managed to get something on that and it drops pitch side for a simple run

they might have got AB here! He's walking off! Ooooohhh boy! He is well short! Short of a length delivery, tucked out towards long-on, to his right. AB hares down and turns for the second. But it is a blistering throw to the keeper's end.  Krunal Pandya has kept Mumbai alive. Runs in fro deep midwicket, one bounce, beats AB's big give by some distance. Stunning, stunning work from Krunal
low full toss at middle stump, offers the full face and drives neatly to mid-off
looks to cream that over cover. It was there, an overpitched ball outside off. Doesn't quite connect. Comes off the toe-end of the bat and plonks into the turf after clearing extra cover. Two
lands the yorker outside off. AB can't get the drive away, it rolls out into the leg side off the inside edge and they take the run
low full toss at off stump, driven along the floor to sweeper cover

Jamieson misjudges and commits to a run, and he is dismissed with ease. It's a low full toss outside off, slammed down the pitch. Bumrah sticks a leg out in the follow through and this trickles behind him, to the left of the stumps. AB's takes a step forward and waits for Jamieson's call. Jamieson runs through and Bumrah has an easy recovery and a walk to the stumps to get him out
yorker at middle stump, squeezed into the leg side

oh get out of here! Unreal. Short of a length ball slanting into his body. He arches into the leg side to create room and lifts this late cut over short third man. Looks like Mumbai wanted to get him off strike with that length, but he's manufactured a boundary
full at leg stump, driven to long-on's right and quickly back for the second

sliced into the boundary padding on the bounce! Bumrah misses the yorker marginally. It's a low full toss at off. AB's front leg is wayyyy outside leg stump and so he has room to go inside-out while traditionally someone might have hit that down the ground. Sweet timing and sent over extra cover
length at middle stump, swatted on the rise to long-on for the single
full and just outside off, crunched past the non-striker to long-off's right

full and just outside off, clears the front leg and drills it past the stumps...and between long-on and long-off! It looked like AB himself didn't think he had enough for a boundary there, he was haring, calling for the second. But that is dead straight and beats long-off to the right
full and at the stumps, looks for the big slog, thick inside edge into the leg side
slower short ball wide outside off, aerial cut on the bounce to sweeper cover
driven over the long-off boundary! A knuckle ball at length, just outside off. Sets up under it and a lovely little golf swing with the hip opening up ever so slightly to place it where he wants
full outside off, driven along the floor to long-off

teamwork from fine leg and third man! Short of a length and into middle stump. Inside edge as he looks to punch. Jansen sprints to the right from fine leg, topples and parries it. Boult converging from the other end has to adjust and fling himself to the left to stop that from running into the boundary padding. He does, and Jansen has recovered by then to get the throw back in
length at leg stump, shuffles and flicks straight to midwicket

Chahar holds on at point! Panic stations? Short and wide outside off, decent connection on the cut but it is hip height and just to Chahar's right. He sticks two soft hands out and that lands neatly. Christian was the big-money finisher for RCB, he departs
yorker just outside off, can't caress this through cover like he tries
yorker at the stumps, can only dig this out to mid-off
length and turning away from off. Steps out, smothers it, and clips it through midwicket
short of a length at off stump, turning away. Punched to sweeper's right off the back foot
length at middle stump, brings out the sweep, gets a top edge out to deep backward square
Kishan cops that on the grille. Length ball down leg side, AB looked to ramp that. Sounded like a connection but replays show it wasn't
drilled far over long-off! What a shot. Can't be easy on this pitch. It's full and tossed up outside off. He's to the pitch of that and gets the swing so clean, inside to out, and connects perfectly
hammered to the cover boundary. Short of a length and turning away from him, gets his weight back and makes no effort to keep this punch down. Past extra cover quickly

he picks out deep square! Jansen has two in the over. It's the night of bowling comebacks. Length and into the body. Uses his bottom hand to shovel this. Decent connection, but straight to the fielder
full and wide outside off, slashes and gets a thick edge out to third man
yorker at middle stump, hurriedly dug out to midwicket
full and slanted in at the stumps. Looks to drive and that comes off the inside of the bat, trickles down the pitch
short of a length at leg stump, uses the angle to tuck that to fine leg
full and down leg side, can't get bat on the flick

ramped straight to short fine! It's a slower short ball at leg stump, he's shaped to get this over the fielder but he's done by the change-up from the young man. It dips for the fielder who tracks it brilliantly as he lunges forward to get his fingers under that. Mumbai have clawed back
short of a length outside off, punched to sweeper cover
short of a length and tight at the stumps, pushed through quick. Hurriedly tapped to extra cover
short of a length outside off, hurried punch past extra cover for the single at long-off
dropped short at middle stump, pulled firmly to deep midwicket
length outside off, pushed to extra cover's left
tentative. Looks like AB was playing for the googly there. The release was one you would see for a googly. Spun away and he defended without leaning in at that
yorker at middle stump, jammed into the leg side
short of a length at leg stump, turned to fine leg off the back foot
length outside off, driven on the rise to extra cover

oh that looks plumb. Good length and slanted into him. He shuffles, but hasn't gone forward as he usually does. Looks to tickle it fine from the crease and he's pinned in front of middle, just above the knee roll. He won't review that
length and into leg stump, clipped to deep square
length outside off, hangs inside the line and drives with an open face. Past point and to third man's right
short of a length outside off, hurried pull to deep midwicket
short of a length and bit turn away outside off, punched to sweeper cover
just misses off! Short of a length and turning away from leg stump. He's through the pull early and that slides under the bat
drops safely. Between three fielders. Full at off stump, steps out and wants to hit straight. Gets too close to it and ends up slicing it over extra cover
full at off stump, gets to the pitch and drives to long-off with the turn
reverse swat and clears deep point. Targeting the shorter side and targeting Chahar again. First ball of the over, just like the last one, he swivels and sends the short ball on its way
length at middle stump, deep in the crease and whipped to deep midwicket
length outside off, steps out and isn't to the pitch. Waits on it and slaps to long-off
length and tossed up at middle stump, driven back at the bowler
slow and at a length at middle stump, opens the face and looks to drop that pitch side for the run. Connects too well
short of a length at off, punched through cover

see ya! He's hit the highest point on the roof at the stadium! 100 metres! Massive, massive shot. Length ball at middle stump, jumps down at that and makes the sweetest sounding connection on this. That FLEW
slower ball at a length on middle stump, poked to mid-on off the back foot
short of a length and very wide outside off, can't reach that
full slower ball outside off, shuffles and drives but can't get that past the diving SKY at point. Leaps and grabs that one-handed
full and wide outside off, can't reach that
good length and slanted in at off stump. Opens the face late in his half crouch and guides that to third man
short and wide outside off, mistimed punch to sweeper
bouncer at off stump, reaches upwards and hooks into the turf to deep square
short of a length at off stump, defended towards point
pushed full and wide outside off, reaches out and drills cleanly to long-off's left
short of a length at leg stump, deep in the crease for the pull but he's through it too soon, toe-ended into the leg side
full outside off, driven to sweeper cover
length and cramped at leg stump as he gets deep for the back-foot whip, cops it on the thigh
length at off stump, punched off the back foot to extra cover
full at middle stump, defended down the pitch
googly, full outside off, driven down to long-off
gorgeous. Simply gorgeous. Length and pushed through flat outside off, extends his arms and goes with the turn to hit this inside-out over extra cover

oh nicely done. Good length and turning away outside off. Hangs deep in the crease, opens the face and chops it between slip and short third man. They sneak a third as Hardik can't get a throw in. An under-arm relay to Rohit. Might have been why his throw was off in that run out opportunity too
short of a length, turning away outside off. Gets deep and punches to long-on
...and he's reverse-watted over point, first ball. Short of a length at middle stump, lots of time to swivel and get that over the infield for his first boundary in RCB colours
full on off stump, driven out to sweeper cover
length at leg stump, clipped to deep square off the back foot
full on off stump, driven straight to extra cover
full at leg stump, swept to deep square's right
length at off stump, defended on the front foot

they've missed the run-out of Virat Kohli. Kohli had no hope of making it back, but the throw from Hardik is marginally wide. It was a length ball, slow, that he defended pitch side. Kohli wanted to pinch that. It wasn't there and Maxwell said so
length at off stump, defended into the covers

chopped on! Slower ball at a length, wide outside off. He shapes to slash that through the off side but is too keen and playing away from the body. Into off stump off the inside edge. A knuckle ball that he hasn't picked
length at middle stump, tucked through midwicket
bouncer, very short and very leg side. Left alone
short of a length, cramped at off stump. Hurriedly patted into the off side
short one slammed in at middle stump, shapes for the pull but the angle on that takes it away and he withdraws
dabbed to third man's left. Short of a length, angled across him. Waits on that and opens the face late, gets it through where second slip might have been
full at leg stump, leans in and flicks to deep midwicket
length at middle stump, deep in the crease for a back foot punch. To deep midwicket's left
length and turning away outside off, watchfully poked to short third
full and into middle stump, leans in and clips towards mid-on

taken at short third man. Pushed across off stump at a length, from around the wicket. Sundar stuck between being forward and back. Has a hack at it and gets a top edge that floats out easily to the fielder. An experiment that fails for RCB on first attempt. For Mumbai, bringing the spinner on has worked
length at middle stump, leans in and flicks to square leg
slower ball, short of a length and just outside off. Backs away for a punch and gets it between cover and extra
full slower ball just outside off, leans in and jabs to extra cover's left
swipes it over short fine. Slower ball, short of a length nonetheless. Kohli was waiting on the back foot and lifted this very deliberately over that fielder
short of a length just outside off, shuffles and gets his weight into the off side on a very awkward pull that just clears midwicket. It is a no-ball for overstepping
short of a length, 139kph and rising above off stump as Sundar makes room and misses on his punch
short of a length, 143kph at leg stump. Walks into that and glances off his thigh
starts with a short one, just outside off, and Kohli is on his toes and swiveling to perfection as he puts this short-arm pull behind square
full and at the stumps, backs away and drives straight to mid-off
beaten on the drive. Curves away in the corridor, on a good length. Looks to drive on the rise and is caught inside the line
short of a length at leg stump, shuffles and tucks it to fine leg's right
overpitched outside off and he's disappointed as he drills this firmly but straight to mid-off
destroyed. Length and very wide. Lots of swinging room. He plants the front leg out and cracks it, almost horizontal batted, on the rise. To sweeper's right
good length and just outside off, dead-batted into the pitch and Kohli is alive for the single
good length and just outside off, shuffles and pushes out to mid-off
good length and into middle stump, hurriedly pushed to mid-on off the back foot
short of a length and too quick for him again, mistimes the cut but it gets past point
lbw appeal but half-hearted. Length ball skids through quickly to hit him in the pads as he's pinned deep in the crease looking to glance. Too quick for him, but also sliding down
length at middle stump, defended down the pitch
full at the stumps, leans in and flicks aerially. Just past midwicket, where Lynn is diving to his right
length and curved into him, punched on the rise with a full face this time. To mid-off
leading edge runs down to the straight boundary! Length and swung in at middle stump. He leans in and looks to flick. Closes the face early and somehow this sprints past mid-off
good length and shaped away outside off, reaches out and steers to third man
full and swung way outside off, driven with an open face to backward point
full and down leg side, beats the flick, Kishan can only get one hand with a frantic drive, and he parries it to the line

dropped at second slip! Rohit Sharma puts it down. Full and curving away. Looks to drive through cover, front leg not quite moving. It's a regulation chance to Rohit's right, he has both hands on it, he's fully balanced, but he can't hold on
good length and a lot of curve away from off stump. Left alone
